summary: Documented the new repo-namespaced storage layout across four project-manifest files.

data-flows.md: Added a new '## Storage Layout' section at the top (before Flow 1) describing the {ledgerRoot}/{repoName}/{slug}/ directory structure with a concrete example tree, the two-level scan algorithm used by listAllProjects(), and the one-time idempotent migration.

constraints.md: Added Constraint 6b — 'Ledger Storage Paths Must Include the Repository Namespace Level' — prohibiting direct join(ledgerRoot, slug) path construction; documents the correct patterns using LedgerStore and resolveProjectDir(); cross-references data-flows.md and api-surface.md.
file-tree.md: Updated the storage/ledger/ tree to show two concrete repo-namespace examples (ai-insights/, other-repo/) and a fallback unknown/ dir, replacing the single {repoName}/ placeholder.

api-surface.md: Added resolveProjectDir() signature and JSDoc immediately after deriveRepoName() in the ledger-root.ts utilities section. migrateToNamespacedLayout() was already documented comprehensively at line 747 in its own dedicated section — no duplicate needed.

comments.note: migrateToNamespacedLayout() was already fully documented at line ~747 in api-surface.md (complete section with MigrationResult interface, EXDEV fallback, crash recovery, startup wiring). Added only resolveProjectDir() in the ledger-root.ts utilities section. Cross-reference comment in Constraint 6b guides readers to both api-surface.md entries.

Constraint 6b uses sub-numbering (6b) rather than a new top-level number to keep it adjacent to Constraint 6 (ledger root resolution) — same subject area. The existing Constraint 7 (STDIO Logging Discipline) is already present so no gap to fill.

summary: Confirming all four original acceptance criteria are met — all document edits were completed in the previous pipeline pass. No new changes required.
